message.text: No invariant tests detected for DeFi protocol shape: Add Foundry invariant tests for accounting, oracle, role, and value-flow assumptions. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

suggested_tests: Add Foundry invariant tests for accounting, oracle, role, and value-flow assumptions.

message.text: Oracle usage lacks visible staleness, TWAP, bounds, or sanity coverage: Document and test oracle freshness, decimals normalization, price bounds, and fallback behavior. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

suggested_tests: Document and test oracle freshness, decimals normalization, price bounds, and fallback behavior.

message.text: Vault accounting lacks visible roundtrip or conservation coverage: Add deposit/withdraw roundtrip tests and totalAssets/share accounting invariants. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

suggested_tests: Add deposit/withdraw roundtrip tests and totalAssets/share accounting invariants.

message.text: External-call value flow needs reentrancy review: Review state update order and add local malicious-receiver tests where callbacks are possible. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

suggested_tests: Review state update order and add local malicious-receiver tests where callbacks are possible.

message.text: Reward accounting needs conservation coverage: Add reward conservation and no-overclaim tests across multiple users and timing boundaries. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

suggested_tests: Add reward conservation and no-overclaim tests across multiple users and timing boundaries.

message.text: Oracle-dependent logic without stale-price tests: Add local mock oracle tests for stale round rejection, heartbeat windows, answeredInRound, and updatedAt behavior. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

properties.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to historical oracle and pricing failure classes where stale or manipulated price state broke protocol assumptions.
suggested_tests: Use a local mock price feed to assert stale or incomplete oracle rounds are rejected or handled according to documented policy.

message.text: Missing price bounds or fallback assumptions documentation: Document min/max bounds, fallback oracle behavior, stale-price policy, and L2 sequencer assumptions if relevant. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

properties.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to failed assumption classes where oracle behavior was implied but not enforced or documented.
suggested_tests: Add documentation plus local tests showing fallback and out-of-bounds price behavior.

message.text: Admin role concentration not documented: Document who can change critical configuration and whether controls use a multisig, timelock, guardian, or single owner. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

properties.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to operational control readiness classes.
suggested_tests: Add a role matrix to docs and unit tests for critical roles.

message.text: External call path without documented ordering assumptions: Document state-update ordering, callback assumptions, and why any unguarded external calls are safe by design. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

properties.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to checks-effects-interactions and callback boundary readiness classes.
suggested_tests: Pair ordering documentation with a local receiver test that exercises the documented boundary.

message.text: Accumulator/index logic without precision/rounding tests: Add precision, dust, rounding, and small-balance tests for accumulator or index logic. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

properties.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to precision and accounting mismatch readiness classes.
suggested_tests: Fuzz stake sizes and reward amounts and assert reward indexes are monotonic and bounded by funded rewards.

message.text: Claim flow without double-claim prevention tests: Add tests proving users cannot claim the same reward entitlement twice. This is a pre-audit readiness gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.

properties.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to duplicate-claim and reward accounting mismatch classes.
suggested_tests: Assert claim twice without new rewards returns zero or reverts according to documented policy.
